slides.texte_overlay:
5 painful truths that change
you as a man

1.
Your parents won't be here forever.
The calls you skip now
are the ones you'll miss most.

2.
Nobody is coming to save you.
That's not bad news.
It means you're in charge.

3.
The world keeps changing.
The men who keep learning
never get left behind.
slides.texte_sophia:
3.
The world keeps changing.
The men who keep learning, even
5 minutes a day on the Sophia app,
never get left behind.

slides.texte_overlay:
4.
Comfort is the slowest way to lose.
Nothing grows where
nothing is hard.

5.
The friends you party with
aren't always the ones who show up.
You find out on your worst day.
